column1: Psychotic Temper - Base (40 - SD Mod)% chance of responding to insult or offense with a killing fit.
column2: Wanted Criminal - Accused of Murder, Banditry, Assassination, Theft, Assault, or Treason.
column3: Blood-Guilt: PC experiences severe guilt if he causes the death or injury of a human, Elf, Halfling or Dwarf.
column4: Chivalrous: Will never fight in an unchivalrous manner; e.g., will always give a human or demi-human opponent first initiative, will never fight horseback against an enemy on foot, always allows the enemy to rearm, etc.
column5: Terrible Fearlessness: Base (40 - SD Mod)% chance of charging heedless into a combat situation
column6: PC is victim of terrible phobia: Details determined by GM.
column7: The PC is a faithful vassal: To a very wicked Lord or Lady.
column8: The PC is superstitious: His morale is influenced by bad "omens".
column9: The PC is passive: -15 to all OB's until he gets "worked up". He may roll once each turn, (20 + SD Mod)% chance.
column10: Martial Arts Training: If a non-monk, PC may train in Martial Arts, Adrenal Moves, and Adrenal Defense as if he were a Monk. If he is a Monk, there is no penalty (i.e., substraction) when using a weapon Kata.
column11: Natual Archer: 25% increase to all bow ranges.
column12: Subtle: Stalk and Hide skill bonus modified by +25.
column13: Mind Over Matter: +25 modification to all Adrenal Moves rolls.
column14: Natural Horseman: +25 bonus to riding bonuses.
column15: Knighted: The PC has been knighted for a personal act of heroism on behalf of a noble or royalty.
column16: Natual Facility With Armor: All armor development costs are cut in half.
column17: Unnatural Stamina: May run at up to 3x normal movement rate and spend only 1 exhaustion point every 60 rounds.
column18: Natural Weapon Master: PC may develop skills ranks in one similar weapons category; all weapons in that category may use that skill rank for their OB's.
column19: Assassin Training: Ambush development costs are cut in half.
column20: Natural Physique: Half development point costs are cut in half.
column21: Hammerhand: Hands hit as maces when using MA Strikes skill; treat as a "Mace" weapon kata with no penalty.
column22: Lucky: May modify any die roll directly concerning the character by either +5 or -5.
column23: Directed Weapon Master: One selected category of weapons yields 3 skill ranks for every 2 ranks developed. All other weapon dev. Pt costs are increased by 50%.
column24: Disarm Skill: PC may intentionally attempt to disarm opponent. Procedure - substract enemy's OB from PC's OB: add open-ended roll; if 101+, enemy must roll RR vs PC's level or lose his weapon.
column25: Immovable Will: Immune to fear and charm attacks. Sleep attacks are halved for attack level and duration.
column26: Tolerance: May take 150% of total hit points before becoming unconscious.
column27: Accerlerated Mending: PC's injuries heal twice as normal.
column28: Unbeliever: Resists magic at 3x level. May not use spells or spell devices.
column29: Animal Friend: Vegetarian; has (35 - Em Mod)% chance each round of befriending any animal within 10' if concentrating. PC may not control animal, but animal will act friendly towards PC indefinitely.
column30: Master Tactician: Has an open-ended chance equal to his IN modification to receive information directly from the GM concerning an immediate tactial situation.
column31: Subconscious Preparation: Readies weapons and bows 1 round quicker than normal.
column32: Trained Regular Footman: May make MA Rank 1 Sweeps/Throws attack each round in addition to normal action.
column33: Danger Sense: GM may warn of general danger on a roll than or equal to the PC's IN modification.
column34: Light Sleeper: PC may make a perception rolls to wake and take action immediately from normal sleep.
column35: Look of Eagles: Those who are allies, troops, or henchmen under the PC never panic while he is well & in sight.
column36: Eye of the Tiger: PC may prepare as for the adrenal move "Strength" except that his chance of success is his level + ((SD Mod + EM Mod)/2). If he succeeds, his OB and DB are modified by +15 for the next round.
column37: Outdoorman: PC gets +50 to all forage, fire starting, and locate shelter rolls while outdoors. He recieves +20 to all Tracking, Trapping, and Stalk/Hide rolls while outdoors.
column38: Portage Skill: Encumbrance Penalties are halved for the PC.
column39: Favored: Liked by a very high ranking noble. May be a relative.
column40: Blessed: PC enjoys the favor of a particular god, demi-god, angel, etc.
column41: Judge of Weaponary: May determine the pluses or minuses, magical and non-magical, on weapons and armor.
column42: Survival Instinct: When using entire OB to parry, the OB is modified by an additional +25.
